test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 16 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

We __hope these measure will take us__ further to a good position.

options.text: hopes these measures will take us
hope these measures will take us
hope those measure will take us

solution:
The correct answer is **"****hope these measures will take us".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"these measure" **is incorrect because the noun **'measure' **needs to agree with the preceding pronoun **'these'. **Therefore, the correct phrase should be **"these measures."**
 
• The use of **'to' **after **'further' **appears to be unnatural. An improvement would be **'towards,' **making the phrase **"further towards a good position," **although it is not explicitly given in the options.
 
• Therefore, the correct rephrasing should be: **"We hope these measures will take us further to a good position."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The hopes these measures will take us" is incorrect, as the subject 'We' has been incorrectly changed to 'The'.
 
• **Option 3: **"hope those measure will take us" is incorrect, as the noun 'measure' should be in the plural form 'measures' and the phrase 'those measure' incorrectly changes 'these' to 'those'.
 
• **Option 4: **"hope these measures will taking" is incorrect because the continuous form of the verb 'taking' is not appropriate in this context. The correct form is 'take'.
